name: Don't Shoot The Messenger
source:
You are a young courier who must deliver news of the war's end. Travel with a mismatched group of soldiers where you navigate dangerous terrain, unexpected encounters, and tricky relationships on the long road to peace.

[From [url=https://indecisiv.itch.io/dont-shoot-the-messenger]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名年轻的信使，必须传递战争结束的消息。与一群不匹配的士兵一起旅行，在通往和平的漫长道路上穿越危险的地形、意想不到的遭遇和棘手的关系。

[来自[url=https://indecisiv.itch.io/dont-shoot-the-messenger]itch.io[/url]]
